hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+commit' && case "$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" in develop|main) true;; *) false;; esac; then echo 'No commitear directamente en develop/main: crea una rama feature/bugfix con git flow (ver AGENTS.md).' >&2; exit 2; fi
